purpose: Compare the specific role and time of Georgetown in three active Guianas tours, actual city inclusions, Kaieteur flight logistics, and differences in included international airfare.

externalSources.supports: St George's Cathedral on the list of Guyana national monuments, not a World Heritage designation.
Historical urban sea-defence Kingston Seawall dated 1860.

notes: Current three active itineraries all include Georgetown, Kaieteur, Suriname and French Guiana, but the capital is in different positions.
The seven-day program includes the Suriname–Guyana flight, while nine- and fourteen-day variants exclude Guyana–Suriname from base price.
Tour source contains potentially misleading UNESCO language about Georgetown; article uses confirmed national monument status rather than claiming World Heritage listing.
Dates, flight availability, visas and supplemental stop inclusions are not invented; public hyperlinks are only canonical internal paths.
